purpose: A warehouse delivery robot navigating between named receiving, storage, packing, dispatch and charging stations
historical_map: bottleneck-v1; explicitly labelled abstract historical benchmark

model.scope: Warehouse demonstration development split; named delivery jobs are excluded from training starts. No independent final assessment.
model.limitations: Single training seed on this familiar warehouse; development evidence, not a new final benchmark. Named jobs were monitored during training.

visual_review.warehouse_floor_image: inspected the actual rendered 2D floor with racks, labelled bays and pickup/goal markers
visual_review.browser_default: verified warehouse selection, named delivery job, pickup/destination descriptions and preserved dark interface
visual_review.browser_3d: working original-map 3D renderer observed; warehouse geometry/labels covered by app serialization tests, warehouse 3D was not separately visually reviewed
visual_review.browser_end: stopped inputs after a user interaction was detected

notes: Delivery is the mission context. The simulator does not model grasping, cargo, people, footprint clearance, live sensors or vertical movement.
